Hi all —

Following up for Evan Torres (SWE/ML candidate). Evan is available next week for a single-block interview and prefers mornings PST. Proposed window: Tue 2027-02-16 or Wed 2027-02-17, 10:00–12:00 PST.

We'd like to run a 45-minute paired coding session followed by a 30-minute ML system design discussion. Can you confirm (a) availability in that window and (b) who will lead each section?

Thanks, Sarah —

Both days look workable for the team; prefer Tue 02/16 to keep momentum. Suggest the following plan:

- 10:00–10:05 brief intro + logistics (Karthik)
- 10:05–10:50 paired coding on CoderPad (Dev as interviewer)
- 10:50–11:00 short break / notes capture
- 11:00–11:30 ML system-design + architecture discussion (Mina leads)
- 11:30–11:45 quick feedback + next steps (Karthik)

A few asks:
- Monica, can you create the CoderPad session and Zoom links and share credentials for the shared interviewer account?
- Dev, can you confirm you'll run the coding portion and whether you want the problem salted or open-ended?
- Mina, any specific focus areas for the design portion (e.g., embedding pipelines, KV caches, serving runtime)?

Evan — does Tue 02/16 10:00 PST work for you? If not, Wed 02/17 same time is fine.

Karthik
